answer: Mechanism: attention-token ledger. Each identity must route inputs through a live attention inlet that demands irregular semantic challenges; a wrong or delayed answer reduces that identity's accrued trust balance by a fixed fraction. An attacker therefore pays the full opportunity cost of one human's uninterrupted monitoring per fake identity, because any lapse can drain the pearl that only sustained attention accumulates. No scalable script can reliably solve the challenges, so the fable of cheap bot farms collapses once the monitoring window exceeds a few hours.
